title: DW3 port text/<lang>/stages.json (named texts for stage talks, stage-text-v1)
description: The lines a stage patch's talks say by name ("text": "<mod>:<name>", docs/stages.md section 8). One file per language folder (eng fra ita ger spa es-419) under the mod's text/ folder; English is required for every name, another language falls back to it (es-419 to Spanish first). The line is written in the readable text syntax of the other text files (docs/modding/README.md) and is fitted to the talk box when the stage starts.

about.description: Free text for people; the game does not read it.

texts.description: The lines by name. The full name a patch uses is "<mod folder>:<name>".
